WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
), mix_shares AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count,
         1.0 * mix_count / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), compared AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM mix_shares
)
SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM compared
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY mix;
